name: foreplay-co
label: Foreplay
description: Competitive advertising data and creative insights platform. Search, filter, and analyze ads and brands with live and historical ad creatives, metadata, and competitive intelligence.

token.label: API Key
token.description: Your Foreplay API key. In Foreplay open the Data API dashboard (https://app.foreplay.co/api-overview) and generate a key.

getAdById.label: Get Ad by ID
getAdById.description: Get detailed information about a specific ad by its public ad library ID. Costs 1 Foreplay credit.

ad_id.label: Public Ad ID
ad_id.description: The public ad library ID: the ad_id field of ads returned by other Foreplay steps (not the internal id field).

get_ad.label: Get Ad
get_ad.description: Get one ad by its public ad library ID.

adId.label: Public Ad ID
adId.description: The adId field of an ad from search results (not the internal id).

get_spyder_brand.label: Get Spyder Brand
get_spyder_brand.description: Get one brand from your Spyder watchlist.
